slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: The exact list varies by lender and loan type, but most applications ask for proof of identity, business registration details, and some form of financial evidence, whether that's full financial statements or several months of bank statements. Having these ready upfront can speed up assessment.

caption:
Every lender asks for slightly different documentation, but a few things come up again and again: proof of identity, business registration details, and some form of financial evidence.

Getting these together before you apply, rather than scrambling once an application is underway, is one of the simplest ways to keep the process moving.
